description: This PHP source file defines the ApplicationSignalsClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP, used for interacting with the Amazon CloudWatch Application Signals service. It specifies a set of methods for managing service signals, such as creating, deleting, listing, and updating service level objectives and dependencies.

classes.description: A client class providing methods to interact with Amazon CloudWatch Application Signals service.
